scope: Actual sparse width-sensitive numerical calibration under the stated regime

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseKhat_factor
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell L q B : ℝ},
  0 < ell →
    0 < L →
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerKhat n ell q B =
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicK n L q B * (L / ell) ^ (2 / q - 1 / 2)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparse_logKhat_sub_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell L q B : ℝ},
  0 < n →
    0 < ell →
      0 < B →
        ell ≤ L →
          L ≤ 3 * ell →
            |Real.log (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerKhat n ell q B) -
                  Real.log (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicK n L q B)| ≤
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseLogSlack q

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth_eq
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ (n : ℕ) {ell q B g : ℝ},
  0 < ell →
    RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth n ell q B g =
      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerScale n ell q B * g / √ell

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth_factor
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell q B g : ℝ},
  0 < n →
    0 < ell →
      2 ≤ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerKhat n ell q B →
        RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth n ell q B g =
          B * g * ell ^ (1 - 1 / q) /
            (2 * (4 * RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerLog n ell q B) ^ (1 - 1 / q) * ↑n ^ (1 / 2 - 1 / q))

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseCoordinateWidth_fourth
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell B g : ℝ},
  0 < ell → 0 ≤ B → RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseCoordinateWidth n ell B g ^ 4 = B ^ 2 * ell ^ 3 * g ^ 4 / ↑n

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth_pos
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell q B g : ℝ},
  0 < n →
    0 < ell →
      0 < B →
        0 < g →
          2 ≤ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerKhat n ell q B →
            0 < RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth n ell q B g

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparse_cube_div_le_coordinateWidth_fourth
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell B g c : ℝ},
  0 < ell →
    2 ≤ B → 0 < c → c ≤ g → ell ^ 3 / ↑n ≤ RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseCoordinateWidth n ell B g ^ 4 / (4 * c ^ 4)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth_le_intrinsicRate
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell L q B g : ℝ},
  2 < q →
    0 < n →
      0 < ell →
        ell ≤ L →
          0 < B →
            0 ≤ g →
              2 ≤ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerKhat n ell q B →
                Real.log (Real.exp 1 + RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicK n L q B) ≤
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerLog n ell q B →
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth n ell q B g ≤
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicRate n L q B g

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicRate_le_raw
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {ell L q B G g : ℝ},
  2 < q →
    0 < n →
      0 < ell →
        0 < L →
          L ≤ 3 * ell →
            0 < B →
              G ≤ 2 * g →
                0 ≤ g →
                  2 ≤ RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerKhat n ell q B →
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.sparseLowerLog n ell q B ≤
                        3 * Real.log (Real.exp 1 + RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicK n L q B) →
                      RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicRate n L q B G ≤
                        256 * RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseRawWidth n ell q B g

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.eventually_lowerSparse_logKhat_sub_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {q : ℝ} {B : ℕ → ℝ} {r m : ℕ → ℕ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ B n) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ r n) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), r n ≤ m n) →
        Filter.Tendsto m Filter.atTop Filter.atTop →
          ∀ᶠ (n : ℕ) in Filter.atTop,

                  Real.log
                    (RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseIntrinsicK n (RectangleCLT.dimensionLog (r n * m n)) q (B n))| ≤
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.lowerSparseLogSlack q
